evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 12.8 ha, 500 m from the road.

plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 105 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 16, Blackwater Rd, Bobtail FSR, Bobtail Grizzly FSR.
Park: 53.32664, -123.62883, pull off on Pelican Lake Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 500 m SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 6 m, about 11 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-13, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AA-duck-walk-0003.recDirections: Follow the Batnunni Road to 118km, turn right onto the P road, follow for 4km and turn left into site
R7AA-duck-walk-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 5-13: about 12,153 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.85 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.5 km and about 6 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

R7AA-grouse-walk-0002.name: By Euchiniko River
R7AA-grouse-walk-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AA-grouse-walk-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Batnuni Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: Trail: Alexander MacKenzie Heritage Trail, 5.7 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
5 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
16 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 110 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 16, Blackwater Rd, Bobtail FSR, Bobtail Grizzly FSR.
Park: 53.29541, -123.60064, pull off on Batnuni Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 140 m to the start. Walk: the Alexander MacKenzie Heritage Trail stretch, 5.7 km one way. About 114 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-13, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
